sudo -n tee /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py >/dev/null <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import json
import os
import socket

DATA_PATH = '/var/lib/inventory-api/inventory.json'

class InventoryHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_json(self, status, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True) + '\n'
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path.split('?', 1)[0]
        if path == '/health':
            self.send_json(200, {'service': 'inventory-api', 'status': 'ok'})
        elif path == '/inventory':
            try:
                with open(DATA_PATH, 'r') as data_file:
                    inventory = json.load(data_file)
                self.send_json(200, inventory)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.send_json(500, {'status': 'error', 'message': str(exc)})
        elif path == '/':
            self.send_json(200, {'service': 'inventory-api', 'hostname': socket.gethostname(), 'endpoints': ['/health', '/inventory']})
        else:
            self.send_json(404, {'status': 'not-found'})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8080), InventoryHandler)
    server.serve_forever()
PY_EOF

if [ "$current_boot_id" != '0571f4dd-60b7-4601-9295-e4eebe622784' ]; then printf 'boot_identity_changed=yes\n'; else printf 'boot_identity_changed=no\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-api.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active inventory-api.service
systemctl show inventory-api.service -p MainPID -p User -p Group -p ExecMainStatus --no-pager
printf 'listener='; sudo -n /bin/netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:8080$/ {print $4, $7}'
printf 'firewall_runtime_8080='; sudo -n firewall-cmd --zone=public --query-port=8080/tcp
printf 'firewall_permanent_8080='; sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --query-port=8080/tcp
printf 'health='; curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; printf '\n'
printf 'inventory='; curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"; printf '\n'
printf 'data_file='; sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory-api/inventory.json
printf 'batchworker_identity='; id batchworker
printf 'batchworker_vmem_kib='; sudo -n /bin/su - batchworker -c 'ulimit -v'
